{{Vanilla|Grindstone}}
{{Infobox auto}}
A '''grindstone''' is a block that repairs items and removes enchantments. [[Matcha Flavoured]] keeps its vanilla recipe and behavior. It is the job site block of the [[Weaponsmith]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

== Usage ==
=== Removing enchantments ===
As in vanilla, placing an item or [[Hell-Bound Book]] in a grindstone removes all its enchantments except curses. The grindstone normally returns some experience, but the pack resets every player's experience to 0 each tick, so that experience is lost.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/anvil_xp/remove_xp.mcfunction}}</ref> Because curses stay, a blank Hell-Bound Book keeps its Curse of Binding.

=== Job site ===
The grindstone is the job site block of the Weaponsmith, which the release notes call the "Grindstone Villager".<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.10|quote=IF YOU WANT THE NEW WEAPON/ARMOUR TWEAKS, use a WEAPONSMITH (Grindstone Villager)}}</ref>
